title: Breakup of Bronson's band at Christmas 1931
summary: Phillips says he stayed with Bronson until the Christmas and New Year's dances of 1931, and that Lester never returned to Bronson.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: That was 1930. But you stayed on until King Oliver took over.
Yeah, I didn't leave. I stayed until 1931.
'32... Well, I went with King in '32.
You mentioned about a Christmas dance in '31.
Yeah, a Christmas dance in Wichita, Kansas.
So that's when he disbanded? That's when King started to take over?
Well, we started rehearsing then. We rehearsed a long time, you know. We started rehearsing, and rehearsed about two months.
First of all, Lester had already left in November 1930, according to this book. Is that right?
Yeah. He left in November 1930, but he left in Scott's Bluff, Nebraska.
Then he didn't come back to the band again.
He never came back to Bronson no more. He came back to King Oliver, if we was in King Oliver's band.
All right. In Christmas of '31, King Oliver wanted to get the band, and he started to rehearse about that time?
No. We didn't start rehearsing the band until '32.
But that's when Bronson broke up?
That's about the last job we played with Bronson, around Christmas of '31. We didn't really have too much booking then. We had a Christmas dance and a New Year's Eve dance.
